prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1349; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The same service was billed twice for the same date, and the provider admitted the second charge was a repeat.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of care, the patient completed 24 visits, a somewhat longer course than typically expected for a cervical and lumbar strain. Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, supporting the presence of soft tissue injury, while neurological screening, straight leg raise, and reflex testing returned normal results. No prior injury or treatment involving the neck or low back is known to this provider. Records review identified a duplicate charge for one date of service; the rendering provider acknowledged that the second entry was a repeat billing and that it does not reflect a separate visit. Treatment included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, with gradual improvement noted. Continued self-directed rehabilitation and follow-up as needed are recommended.
